addendum_authorized_519_december_regener: 2026-08-07: USER-AUTHORIZED production write — scripts/repair_shadow_reports.py (renamed/generalised from repair_shadow_impossible_reach.py so both passes share ONE proven guard chain; no parallel repair surface). INVESTIGATION: (1) SCHEMA re-confirmed by information_schema, not assumption — property_reports(id uuid, product, address, lat, lng, prop_id, run_date date, inputs jsonb, outputs jsonb, confidence, data_sources ARRAY, created_at). NO version/stale column, which is why invalidation was ruled out. Scenarios live at outputs->'scenarios'. (2) SELECTION PREDICATE: outputs->'repair' IS NULL AND a dec21_12pm scenario exists — measured 519 (538 corpus minus the 19 already regenerated in PR #883). Self-excluding, so the run is resumable and idempotent by construction. (3) LOOP INVARIANT: every written row gains outputs.repair, so it leaves the pending set on the next pass; termination bounded by corpus size; a NULL/no-op regeneration is impossible because _regenerate_outputs always writes the tag. (4) TIMEOUT RISK: one full-corpus SELECT (538 rows, sub-second) plus per-row UPDATE by primary key; statement_timeout 30s; writes BATCHED (default 50/transaction) so no transaction holds locks across the corpus — partial completion is safe and resumable rather than lost. (5) NUMERIC PARSING: height_m cast jsonb->numeric; shadow_length_m / shadow_overlap_fraction / shadow_direction_deg are all genuinely nullable on repaired rows and are narrowed at the point of use. (6) NO join keys, no entity-name mapping. (7) PRESERVED FIELDS asserted, not assumed: construction_change_score/_detected/_note and s2_latest_acquisition must be byte-identical before and after; the dry run aborts the whole run if any row would change them. (8) BLAST RADIUS is computed and reported BEFORE any write, broken down by which customer-visible verdict changes (ADG, confidence, worst-case, scenario-became-unavailable, compass letter).

findings_summary: NO DB WRITES AND NO SCHEMA CHANGE — this is pure computation plus copy; the only DB work was READ-ONLY measurement (psycopg2 set_session(readonly=True)) over property_reports WHERE product='shadow'. Schema confirmed by query, not assumption: property_reports(id, product, address, lat, lng, prop_id, run_date, inputs jsonb, outputs jsonb, confidence, data_sources); scenarios live at outputs->'scenarios' as a jsonb array, NOT a column. 538 stored reports, 201 distinct prop_id, 212 distinct coordinates, run_date 2026-04-07..2026-07-30, zero null coords. Key discoveries: (1) DST defect is confined to dec21_12pm — hour_utc=2 is 13:00 AEDT, labelled 12:00; the other four are AEST and correct. (2) Four of the five stored direction_deg constants reproduce suncalc at Sydney CBD to <=0.09 deg and were real measurements; only 183.0 (December) matches no computable instant, out 11.4 deg. (3) pybdshadow derives sun position from suncalc, not pvlib, and suncalc agrees with pvlib to 0.30 deg bearing / 0.18 deg altitude across 1,060 comparisons at the 212 real served locations — so the shadow POLYGON was always sound; only the label and the constant were wrong. (4) construction_change_detected is false on all 538 and no report has ever carried a non-zero change score: 231 'Insufficient cloud-free scenes', 10 timeouts, 5 null, and 292 pre-June rows all holding exactly 0.0 before the note key existed. The PDF renders 'No significant ground disturbance detected on adjacent lots' on all 538 from a check that never produced a reading. (5) The measurement behind that claim is a 400x400 m (16 ha) bbox mean BSI containing the subject's own lot and ~250-350 others, with SWIR at 20 m resolution — one suburban lot is ~1.25 pixels, so per-parcel attribution is impossible at this sensor, not merely expensive. (6) NEW, not in the brief: 19 of 538 reports serve a physically impossible shadow reach (worst 1,779.5 m from a 9 m building); reach/ceiling is bimodal with p95=1.004 then a jump to p99=13.5, and thresholds of 1.1/1.25/1.5 all select the same 19 reports. No join keys, no loops, no batch operations, no entity-name mapping, no numeric parsing of DB text. Timeout risk: none — heaviest query is a LATERAL jsonb_array_elements over 538 rows, sub-second. Main risk verified before shipping: the per-address bearing must not regress the four constants that were correct — pinned by test_the_old_december_constant_would_now_fail.
